designators.label: Cancel
designators.description: Cancel designated building, mining, hauling, harvesting, and all other designations.

designators.label: Deconstruct
designators.description: Deconstruct this and reclaim part of its resources.

designators.label: Smooth walls
designators.description: Designate rough stone walls to be smoothed.

designators.label: Remove foundation
designators.description: Remove bridges or gravship substructure to reveal the terrain underneath.

designators.label: Replace
designators.description: Replace stuff of a thing, e.g. replace a wood wall with stone

designators.label: bridge
designators.description: A flat wooden surface on supportive beams which can be built over water. You can build light structures on bridges, but be careful - bridges are fragile. If a bridge falls, buildings on top of it fall as well.

designators.label: heavy bridge
designators.description: A stronger version of the basic bridge which supports heavy structures on top. You can build a whole colony on water with this.

designators.label: wooden door (1x1)
designators.description: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

designators.label: autodoor (1x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: animal flap...
designators.description: A doorway hung with thick overlapping strips of fabric or leather. It allows animals to pass while insulating the temperature. Animal flaps are commonly used as barn doors to give penned animals a sheltered place to sleep.

designators.label: ornate door...
designators.description: Divides rooms. An intricately-carved door, decorated with gold. This large, heavy door requires adjacent walls to function.

designators.label: steel wall
designators.description: An impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.

designators.label: fence...
designators.description: A fence made of posts joined by crossbars used for building pens for certain kinds of animals. Some kinds of animals can get past fences. Predators will not hunt creatures on the other side of a fence, but may still wander inside.

designators.label: fence gate...
designators.description: A simple gate made of posts and crossbars. It blocks some animals like a fence. Handlers can lead animals in and out of the pen through these gates.

designators.label: column...
designators.description: A column capable of holding a roof. Does not block sight or movement and looks quite nice.

designators.label: security door
designators.description: A heavily reinforced door. It is slow to open and requires electricity, but is very strong. It's a good choice if you want to keep something dangerous out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function.

designators.label: door (2x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

designators.label: door (3x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

designators.label: autodoor (2x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: autodoor (3x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: jail door...
designators.description: Sliding jail cell door with strong bars.

designators.label: curtain (tribal) (1x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Curtains are much faster to open than standard doors, but are flammable and slowly vent temperatures between rooms.

designators.label: curtain (tribal) (2x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Curtains are much faster to open than standard doors, but are flammable and slowly vent temperatures between rooms.

designators.label: curtain (tribal) (3x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Curtains are much faster to open than standard doors, but are flammable and slowly vent temperatures between rooms.

designators.label: gate (2x1)...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

designators.label: blast door (1x1)...
designators.description: A heavy door that is far more resilient to damage. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: blast door (2x1)...
designators.description: A heavy pair of doors that are far more resilient to damage. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: blast door (3x2)...
designators.description: A heavy pair of doors that are far more resilient to damage. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: door button
designators.description: A button that connects to doors (functions the same as a lever).

designators.label: door lever
designators.description: A lever that connects to doors (functions the same as a button).

designators.label: remote door (1x1)...
designators.description: Vertical sliding metal door. Uses less power than an autodoor but opens more slowly. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: remote door (2x1)...
designators.description: Vertical sliding metal door. Uses less power than an autodoor but opens more slowly. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: remote door (3x1)...
designators.description: Vertical sliding metal door. Uses less power than an autodoor but opens more slowly. Can be opened and closed from a distance with a button or lever.

designators.label: large security door
designators.description: A heavily reinforced door. It is slow to open and requires electricity, but is very strong. It's a good choice if you want to keep something dangerous out - or in. The door requires walls on either side to function.

designators.label: glass autodoor...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.

designators.label: reinforced glass autodoor...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.

designators.label: double door...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

designators.label: double autodoor...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.

designators.label: large ornate door...
designators.description: Divides rooms. An intricately-carved door, decorated with gold. This large, heavy door requires adjacent walls to function.

designators.label: cell door...
designators.description: A slow moving door that separates two rooms.

designators.label: wall armor...
designators.description: A durable, reinforced armor that seamlessly integrates with existing walls. Provides enhanced protection against external threats while maintaining structural integrity. It will protect the wall under it from damage until destroyed. Must be constructed on an existing wall.

designators.label: rustic wall...
designators.description: A simplistic, weak and impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.

designators.label: ornate wall...
designators.description: An intricate and impassable wall, decorated with gold. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Dignity-focused psycaster will receive a meditation bonus when meditating near them.

designators.label: clerestory wall...
designators.description: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.

designators.label: reinforced clerestory wall...
designators.description: An impassable half-glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.

designators.label: glass wall...
designators.description: An impassable glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof, but far more fragile than a normal wall. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.

designators.label: reinforced glass wall...
designators.description: An impassable reinforced glass wall. Capable of holding up a roof. Does not block light, providing a growing bonus to plants near them. Slowly refills peoples outdoor need.

designators.label: cell wall...
designators.description: An impassable wall consisting of metal bars.

designators.label: barriers wall...
designators.description: An impassable wall consisting of metal bars that allow water to pass through. Must be constructed in water.

designators.label: remote door...
designators.description: Divides rooms. Can be activated only by a remote controller.

designators.label: remote embrasure...
designators.description: A special type of wall which has an remote accesible mechanism which when activated an opening in the wall appears allowing you to shoot and throw granades.

designators.label: hidden door (metallic)...
designators.description: A door that blends in with smooth walls. Put a wall link in the same tile to make it link to adjacent walls.

designators.label: hidden autodoor (metallic)...
designators.description: An autodoor that blends in with smooth walls. Put a wall link in the same tile to make it link to adjacent walls. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
